hooks.command:
bash -c 'input=$(cat); command=$(echo "$input" | grep -o "\"command\"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*\"[^\"]*" | sed "s/\"command\"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*\"//" | awk "{print \$1}"); allowed_commands="ls
cat
grep
find
head
tail
wc
echo
pwd
whoami
date
uname
df
du
tree
file
which
env
printenv
history
stat"; if [ -z "$command" ]; then exit 0; fi; if echo "$allowed_commands" | grep -qx "$command"; then exit 0; fi; echo "{"decision": "deny", "reason": "🔒 STRICT MODE: The command '"'"'$command'"'"' is not in the whitelist. Only read-only operations are allowed: ls, cat, grep, find, head, tail, wc, echo, pwd, whoami, date, uname, df, du, tree, file, which, env, printenv, history, stat. If you need to modify files, please ask for permission to extend the whitelist."}"; exit 2'
